008package paint.shared.utils;
009
010import java.io.InputStream;
011import java.net.URL;
012import java.security.CodeSource;
013import java.time.*;
014import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
015import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
016import java.util.Enumeration;
017import java.util.jar.Attributes;
018import java.util.jar.JarFile;
019import java.util.jar.Manifest;
020
021/**
022 * Static utility for reading manifest metadata from JAR archives.
023 * <p>
024 * The {@code JarInfoLogger} reads manifest files, extracts implementation
025 * details (title, version, vendor, build date), and formats time data into
026 * Amsterdam time for uniform reporting. It can operate on any class
027 * contained in a JAR file.
028 */
029public final class JarInfoLogger {
030
031    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
032    // CONSTANTS
033    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
034
035    private static final ZoneId            AMS     = ZoneId.of("Europe/Amsterdam");
036    private static final DateTimeFormatter OUT_FMT =
037            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss z").withZone(AMS);
038
039    /**
040     * Prevents instantiation of this static utility class.
041     */
042    private JarInfoLogger() {
043        // Prevent instantiation
044    }
045
046    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
047    // PUBLIC API
048    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
049
050    /**
051     * Reads JAR manifest information for the given class.
052     * <p>
053     * The method first attempts to locate the manifest in the JAR containing
054     * the provided class. If not found, it scans the classpath for the first
055     * available {@code META-INF/MANIFEST.MF}.
056     *
057     * @param clazz the class from which to derive the JAR source
058     * @return a {@link JarInfo} object containing manifest metadata, or {@code null} if unavailable
059     */
060    public static JarInfo getJarInfo(Class<?> clazz) {
061        try {
062            // Try to load from the JAR that defined this class
063            Manifest manifest = manifestFromCodeSource(clazz);
064            if (manifest == null) {
065                // Fallback: first MANIFEST.MF on classpath
066                manifest = manifestFromClasspath(clazz);
067            }
068            if (manifest == null) {
069                return null;
070            }
071
072            Attributes attribute   = manifest.getMainAttributes();
073            String     ts          = attribute.getValue("Build-Timestamp"); // optional
074            String     formattedTs = formatAmsterdam(ts);
075
076            return new JarInfo(
077                    attribute.getValue("Implementation-Title"),
078                    attribute.getValue("Implementation-Version"),
079                    attribute.getValue("Implementation-Vendor"),
080                    formattedTs
081            );
082        } catch (Exception e) {
083            PaintLogger.errorf("JarInfoLogger.getJarInfo(): %s", e);
084            return null;
085        }
086    }
087
088    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
089    // INTERNAL HELPERS
090    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
091
092    /**
093     * Attempts to read a manifest directly from the JAR file that defined
094     * the specified class.
095     *
096     * @param clazz class whose code source will be used to locate the JAR
097     * @return the parsed {@link Manifest}, or {@code null} if unavailable
098     */
099    private static Manifest manifestFromCodeSource(Class<?> clazz) {
100        try {
101            CodeSource cs = clazz.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource();
102            if (cs == null) {
103                return null;
104            }
105
106            URL loc     = cs.getLocation();
107            String path = loc.toString();
108
109            if (path.endsWith(".jar") || path.contains(".jar!")) {
110                try (JarFile jf = new JarFile(loc.getPath().replace("file:", ""))) {
111                    return jf.getManifest();
112                } catch (Exception ignored) {
113                    String jarUrl = (path.endsWith(".jar")
114                            ? "jar:" + path + "!/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF"
115                            : path.substring(0, path.indexOf("!")) + "!/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF");
116                    try (InputStream is = new URL(jarUrl).openStream()) {
117                        return new Manifest(is);
118                    }
119                }
120            }
121            return null;
122        } catch (Exception e) {
123            return null;
124        }
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Reads the first available {@code META-INF/MANIFEST.MF} from the classpath.
129     *
130     * @param clazz class whose {@link ClassLoader} will be used for resource lookup
131     * @return the first {@link Manifest} found, or {@code null} if none exist
132     */
133    private static Manifest manifestFromClasspath(Class<?> clazz) {
134        try {
135            ClassLoader cl = clazz.getClassLoader();
136            Enumeration<URL> en = cl.getResources("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF");
137
138            if (en.hasMoreElements()) {
139                URL u = en.nextElement();
140                try (InputStream is = u.openStream()) {
141                    return new Manifest(is);
142                }
143            }
144        } catch (Exception ignored) {
145        }
146        return null;
147    }
148    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
149    // DATE/TIME UTILITIES
150    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
151
152    /**
153     * Converts a UTC timestamp string to Amsterdam local time, formatted as
154     * {@code yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss z}.
155     * <p>
156     * Supported input formats:
157     * <ul>
158     *   <li>ISO 8601 (e.g. {@code 2025-10-14T06:39:16Z})</li>
159     *   <li>{@code yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} (assumed UTC)</li>
160     *   <li>{@code yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX}</li>
161     * </ul>
162     *
163     * @param utcString raw timestamp string from the manifest
164     * @return formatted string (e.g., {@code "2025-10-14 08:39:16 CET"}), or {@code null} if invalid
165     */
166    public static String formatAmsterdam(String utcString) {
167        if (utcString == null || utcString.trim().isEmpty()) {
168            return null;
169        }
170
171        // Try ISO 8601 (e.g. 2025-10-14T06:39:16Z)
172        try {
173            Instant ins = Instant.parse(utcString.trim());
174            return OUT_FMT.format(ins);
175        } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {
176        }
177
178        // Try "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" (assume UTC)
179        try {
180            LocalDateTime ldt = LocalDateTime.parse(utcString.trim(),
181                                                    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
182            return OUT_FMT.format(ldt.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC));
183        } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {
184        }
185
186        // Try "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"
187        try {
188            OffsetDateTime odt = OffsetDateTime.parse(utcString.trim(),
189                                                      DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"));
190            return OUT_FMT.format(odt.toInstant());
191        } catch (DateTimeParseException ignored) {
192        }
193
194        return null;
195    }
196
197    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
198    // MAIN (DEMO / TEST DRIVER)
199    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
200
201    /**
202     * Prints manifest information for this utility’s own class.
203     * <p>
204     * Intended for manual or command-line testing.
205     *
206     * @param args command-line arguments (unused)
207     */
208    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
209    // NESTED DATA STRUCTURE
210    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
211
212    /**
213     * Immutable container class for JAR manifest metadata.
214     */
215    public static final class JarInfo {
216
217        public final String implementationTitle;
218        public final String implementationVersion;
219        public final String implementationVendor;
220        public final String implementationDate;
221
222        /**
223         * Constructs a new {@code JarInfo} container with all metadata values.
224         *
225         * @param implTitle   implementation title
226         * @param implVersion implementation version
227         * @param implVendor  implementation vendor
228         * @param implDate    implementation build date/time
229         */
230        public JarInfo(String implTitle,
231                       String implVersion,
232                       String implVendor,
233                       String implDate) {
234            this.implementationTitle   = implTitle;
235            this.implementationVersion = implVersion;
236            this.implementationVendor  = implVendor;
237            this.implementationDate    = implDate;
238        }
239
240        /**
241         * @return a concise human-readable summary of implementation metadata.
242         */
243        @Override
244        public String toString() {
245            return String.format(
246                    "Implementation Title  : %s%n" +
247                            "Implementation Version: %s%n" +
248                            "Implementation Vendor : %s%n" +
249                            "Implementation Date   : %s%n",
250                    implementationTitle, implementationVersion,
251                    implementationVendor, implementationDate
252            );
253        }
254
255    }
256}
